_comment: Playwright-local Firebase emulator config. Kept separate from the project's top-level firebase.json (which configures Flutter platforms + hosting for prod) so test infrastructure never leaks into release configuration. Reference: playwright/src/lifecycle/emulators.ts spawns `firebase emulators:start --config <this file>`. Auth-only by default — the Filhos backend is a REST API at criarte.filhos.app, not Cloud Functions. Add `firestore` / `storage` / `functions` blocks when a scenario needs them.
